description: Fetches any public http(s) page and returns its metadata: title, meta description, canonical URL, favicon URL, all OpenGraph (og:*) properties, and every unique absolute link with its anchor text (up to 500). Blocks localhost and private addresses. Returns JSON with url, final_url, status, title, description, canonical, favicon, og, link_count and links. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/page-metadata.
name: page-metadata
